{{Top|leg}}
The '''Great Hoary Mastmot Trading Station''' was a trading post on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toola/Legends|Toola]]. Previously run by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Spetbecca]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] it was operated by [[Haaken Baranar]]. It consisted of two large prefabricated buildings.
